names.zh: 拉帕尔马岛（加那利群岛）

tips.zh: 海拔高、常处于云海之上；天文台周边住宿需提前预订，山路弯多。
tips.en: High altitude, often above the clouds; book accommodation near the observatory well in advance; winding roads.

region.zh: 西班牙 · 加那利群岛

tips.zh: 火山公园内光害极低，需自驾并注意夜间道路管制。
tips.en: Very dark volcanic national park; self-drive needed and watch for night road restrictions.

names.zh: 莫纳克亚游客中心（夏威夷）

tips.zh: 游客中心海拔约 2800 米，免费开放；注意保暖和高原反应，山顶区域不对公众开放。
tips.en: The visitor center sits at ~2,800 m and is free; dress warmly, mind altitude, and the summit itself is restricted.

names.zh: 樱桃泉暗夜公园（宾夕法尼亚）

region.zh: 美国 · 宾夕法尼亚州

tips.zh: 北美著名暗夜公园，夏季银河与英仙座观测条件极佳；露营需预约。
tips.en: Famous US dark-sky park, superb for the Perseids and Milky Way in summer; camping requires reservations.

names.zh: 弗拉格斯塔夫（亚利桑那）

tips.zh: 世界上第一个国际暗天城市，周边高原干燥少云，全年适合观星。
tips.en: The world's first International Dark Sky City; dry high-desert skies suit observing year-round.

tips.zh: 世界海拔最高的暗夜保护区之一，干燥少云；需适应高反，冬季极寒，提前办好边防手续。
tips.en: One of the highest dark-sky reserves on Earth; dry and clear, but altitude, extreme winter cold, and border permits apply.

tips.zh: 沙漠观星，晴天率高、视野开阔；昼夜温差大，注意防风沙保暖。
tips.en: Desert skies with high clear-sky rates and open horizons; large temperature swings, wind and sand require preparation.

tips.zh: 全球最干燥地区之一，南半球流星雨（宝瓶座 η、双子座等）首选；夜间寒冷。
tips.en: Among the driest places on Earth; top choice for southern showers (Eta Aquariids, Geminids); cold at night.

tips.zh: 认证暗空保护区，南半球冬季银河壮丽；住宿点较分散，需四驱车。
tips.en: Certified dark-sky reserve with a magnificent southern winter Milky Way; lodges are scattered and 4x4 helps.

tips.zh: 南半球高纬暗空，天气多变，出发前务必确认云量预报。
tips.en: High-latitude southern dark skies but changeable weather; always check the cloud forecast first.

region.zh: 中国 · 粤港澳大湾区

tips.zh: 广州北部山区，驾车约 1.5–2 小时，村里有民宿；东北方向视野开阔，适合看英仙座方向。
tips.en: Mountains north of Guangzhou, ~1.5–2 h drive with village guesthouses; open north-east horizon suits the Perseid radiant.

region.zh: 中国 · 粤港澳大湾区

tips.zh: 深圳天文台周边海滩，夜间人少；注意潮汐、安全与离场交通。
tips.en: Beaches near the Shenzhen Observatory, quiet at night; mind tides, safety, and getting out late.

region.zh: 中国 · 粤港澳大湾区

tips.zh: 惠东山区林场，光害较低；进山道路较窄，夜晚驾车需谨慎。
tips.en: Forest hills in Huidong with lower light pollution; narrow mountain roads need careful night driving.

names.zh: 西贡 / 麦理浩径（香港）

tips.zh: 郊野公园内，部分路段公共交通可达；注意补给、野猪与手机信号。
tips.en: Country park with some public-transport access; plan supplies, be aware of wild boars and patchy signal.

region.zh: 中国 · 粤港澳大湾区

tips.zh: 离肇庆市区近，山顶视野好；注意景区开放时间与夜爬限制。
tips.en: Close to Zhaoqing with good summit views; check opening hours and night-access rules.

region.zh: 中国 · 粤港澳大湾区

tips.zh: 海岛东侧沙滩朝向大海视野开阔，适合看低角度辐射点；夏季注意台风。
tips.en: East-facing beaches open to the sea suit low-altitude radiants; watch for typhoons in summer.

tips.zh: 距北京约 200 公里，草原视野开阔、光害低；夏季凉爽，注意防蚊与早晚温差。
tips.en: About 200 km from Beijing with open grassland skies; cool summers, mind mosquitoes and temperature swings.

tips.zh: 距北京约 400 公里，风电场草原开阔、晴天率高，是华北观星优选。
tips.en: About 400 km from Beijing; open windy grassland with high clear-sky rates — a top northern China option.

tips.zh: 台顶视野开阔、光害低，适合太原、北京方向出发；注意海拔与景区夜爬规定。
tips.en: Open summit views with low light pollution, reachable from Taiyuan or Beijing; mind altitude and night-access rules.

tips.zh: 华东著名暗空点，距杭州、上海约 2–3 小时车程；山顶设有天文台，注意天气与旺季人流。
tips.en: A famous East China dark site, 2–3 h from Hangzhou or Shanghai; an observatory sits on the summit — check weather and crowds.

tips.zh: 高原湿地草原，视野极开阔，距成都约 8 小时车程；海拔高需防高反。
tips.en: Vast highland wetland plains with enormous horizons, ~8 h from Chengdu; altitude precautions required.

tips.zh: 高原暗空、晴天率高，距昆明约 1 小时飞行或 8 小时车程；注意高反与保暖。
tips.en: High-altitude dark skies with high clear-sky rates; reachable from Kunming by a short flight — mind altitude and cold.

tips.zh: 距西安约 1.5 小时，山顶光害低、视野开阔；夜爬需注意安全与门票时段。
tips.en: About 1.5 h from Xi'an with dark, open summit views; night hiking needs safety care and ticket timing.

tips.zh: 华中高山林区，光害低，距武汉约 5 小时车程；注意山路、天气与季节。
tips.en: High mountain forests of central China with low light pollution, ~5 h from Wuhan; mind mountain roads and weather.

tips.zh: 高山草甸视野开阔，适合长沙、南昌方向出发；山顶风大，注意保暖。
tips.en: Alpine meadows with wide horizons, good for trips from Changsha or Nanchang; windy summit, dress warmly.

tips.zh: 距济南约 1 小时，山顶光害低；夜爬须按景区规定，提前查开放时段。
tips.en: About 1 h from Jinan with a dark summit; night hiking follows park rules — check opening times first.

tips.zh: 腾格里沙漠边缘，干燥少云、晴天率高；注意风沙与昼夜温差。
tips.en: Edge of the Tengger Desert — dry, clear and high clear-sky rates; mind sand, wind and temperature swings.

tips.zh: “天空之镜”盐湖暗空极佳，距西宁约 2.5 小时；注意保暖与高反。
tips.en: The mirror-salt-lake dark site is superb, ~2.5 h from Xining; dress warmly and mind altitude.

tips.zh: 距乌鲁木齐约 1 小时，夏季凉爽、晴天率高；山区夜间驾车注意安全。
tips.en: About 1 h from Urumqi; cool summers and high clear-sky rates — drive mountain roads carefully at night.

tips.zh: 距拉萨约 2 小时，海拔高、光害极低；注意高反、保暖与边防手续。
tips.en: About 2 h from Lhasa at high altitude with pristine skies; mind altitude, cold and permit requirements.

tips.zh: 华南最高峰之一，常处于云海之上；登山需提前预约，注意山路。
tips.en: One of South China's highest peaks, often above the clouds; book access in advance and mind mountain roads.

tips.zh: 热带雨林山区，海拔高、光害低，距海口约 3 小时；雨季注意天气。
tips.en: Tropical forest mountains with altitude and dark skies, ~3 h from Haikou; watch the wet season.

tips.zh: 台湾最佳观星点之一，距台北约 3 小时；注意高山路况、保暖与住宿预约。
tips.en: One of Taiwan's best stargazing sites, ~3 h from Taipei; mind mountain roads, cold and accommodation bookings.

tips.zh: 距东京约 1.5 小时，视野开阔、光害较低；冬季寒冷，注意保暖。
tips.en: About 1.5 h from Tokyo with open, relatively dark skies; cold in winter, dress warmly.

tips.zh: 欧洲最大的暗夜公园之一，距伦敦约 5 小时车程；云图是出发前必查项。
tips.en: One of Europe's largest dark-sky parks, ~5 h from London; check the cloud map before leaving.

names.zh: 约书亚树国家公园（美国）

tips.zh: 距洛杉矶约 2.5 小时，沙漠暗空、晴天率高；夜间注意寒冷与野生动物。
tips.en: About 2.5 h from Los Angeles with desert-dark skies and high clear-sky rates; cold nights and wildlife.

names.zh: 优胜美地国家公园（美国）

tips.zh: 距旧金山约 3 小时，山谷暗空、银河壮丽；住宿需提前预订。
tips.en: About 3 h from San Francisco with dark valley skies and a stunning Milky Way; book lodging early.

tips.zh: 距首尔约 2.5 小时，山岳暗空、空气通透；注意冬季严寒。
tips.en: About 2.5 h from Seoul with mountain-dark skies and crisp air; winter can be severe.

tips.zh: 距新加坡约 2 小时，东海岸暗空较好；留意季风与雨季。
tips.en: About 2 h from Singapore with the darker skies of the east coast; watch the monsoon season.

tips.zh: 距曼谷约 2.5 小时，国家公园暗空、视野开阔；旱季出发最佳。
tips.en: About 2.5 h from Bangkok with park-dark skies and open views; the dry season is best.

tips.zh: 距悉尼约 1.5 小时，内陆山区视野好、光害低；注意山路与野火季。
tips.en: About 1.5 h from Sydney with open inland horizons and lower light pollution; mind mountain roads and bushfire season.

tips.zh: 距迪拜约 2.5 小时，沙漠暗空、晴天率极高；注意沙尘与昼夜温差。
tips.en: About 2.5 h from Dubai with desert-dark skies and exceptional clear-sky rates; mind dust and temperature swings.

region.zh: 中国 · 粤港澳大湾区

tips.zh: 市区北部约 30 分钟车程，比市中心明显更暗；山顶视野开阔，可看北偏东方向。
tips.en: About 30 min north of downtown and noticeably darker; open summit views toward the north-east.

region.zh: 中国 · 粤港澳大湾区

tips.zh: 距市中心约 40 分钟，郊野公园内光害较低；需自带饮水补给，注意蚊虫。
tips.en: About 40 min from downtown inside a country park with lower light pollution; bring water and repellent.

tips.zh: 市区西郊，比市中心略暗；夜间登山注意园区开放时间与安全。
tips.en: West of downtown and a bit darker; night visits depend on park hours and require care.

tips.zh: 临港东南角，面海视野开阔，比市区暗一档；注意海风、保暖与离场交通。
tips.en: South-east Lingang with open sea horizons and slightly darker skies; mind sea winds and getting back late.

tips.zh: 市区西南郊野公园，约 30 分钟可达；山脊视野好，注意天黑后下山安全。
tips.en: A country park south-west of downtown, ~30 min away; good ridge views, mind the descent after dark.

names.zh: 龙泉山城市森林公园（成都）

tips.zh: 市区东侧森林公园，约 1 小时可达；海拔不高，适合就近练手。
tips.en: A forest park east of the city, ~1 h away at modest altitude — a good close-to-home option.

tips.zh: 光谷东侧山体，比市中心略暗；适合快速就近观测。
tips.en: Hills east of Optics Valley, slightly darker than downtown — handy for a quick session.

tips.zh: 临潼骊山，距市中心约 40 分钟；山顶视野开阔，夜爬注意安全。
tips.en: Lishan in Lintong, ~40 min from downtown with open summit views; night hiking needs care.

tips.zh: 市区高地，比市中心略暗；避开天文台灯光区域，选择开阔处。
tips.en: High ground in the city, a bit darker than downtown; avoid observatory lights and pick an open spot.

tips.zh: 南岸高地，比两江核心区略暗；雾季可见度低，选晴天出发。
tips.en: High ground on the south bank, darker than the core districts; foggy season hurts visibility — go on clear days.

tips.zh: 全港最高峰，麦理浩径可至；注意山顶天气突变与离场交通。
tips.en: Hong Kong's highest peak, reachable via the MacLehose Trail; watch for sudden summit weather and late transport.

tips.zh: 市区北郊，硫磺谷一带光害低、视野好；夜间注意硫磺气味与保暖。
tips.en: North of the city with darker skies around the sulfur valley; mind the smell and night-time cold.

tips.zh: 东京近郊，缆车可达，冬季晴朗夜多；注意末班车时间。
tips.en: Tokyo's nearest mountain, cable-car accessible, with many clear winter nights; watch the last train.

names.zh: 布雷肯比肯斯（英国威尔士）

tips.zh: 国际暗空保护区，距伦敦约 3 小时车程；英国境内少有的真正暗空。
tips.en: An International Dark Sky Reserve about 3 h from London — rare truly dark skies in the UK.
